sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Hunt is the assassin Soul fights on the moving cart during the game's opening, and the October 2026 footage shows him again as a full encounter rather than a scripted escape. He is built around relentless pressure rather than single heavy hits: coverage describes the danger as death by a hundred small cuts, which sounds punishing but is also what makes him readable, because his aggression keeps creating parry windows.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: Not confirmed pre-launch. Bosses in Phantom Blade Zero are described by S-GAME as rewarding unique weapons on defeat, but no drop table has been published for this encounter, so none is listed here.

sections.title: How to Beat the The Hunt
sections.content:
What has actually been shown

  • Fights with a pair of one-handed axes joined by a chain, used for rapid strikes followed by disengaging withdrawals
  • A move that looks like an acrobatic backward somersault is the wind-up for throwing one of the axes
  • Second phase: he grows two additional arms, each carrying another axe, so the fight becomes four-axe coverage
  • His style is described as aggressive rather than tanky, with constant openings for a player who can read the chain attacks
  • What weapon or reward he grants has not been announced, despite store copy saying weapons are taken from fallen foes

Everything above comes from footage S-GAME released. Anything not listed has not been shown, however confident a write-up elsewhere looks.

How to approach it

  • Everything here comes from preview footage, so treat it as expectation rather than strategy: the numbers, ranges and any guard-break timings are unknown until the full build is public
  • The somersault is the tell worth learning from the clip - if you read it as evasion you will whiff a parry on what is actually an attack
  • A second phase with four axes is a coverage problem more than a damage problem, which is the kind of fight where a longer Phantom Edge or a change of weapon tends to matter more than raw damage
